topics.topic: TypeScript's baseUrl option getting removed in TypeScript 7
topics.angle: TypeScript's own tsconfig reference confirms baseUrl is deprecated and dies in TypeScript 7, so show exactly what replaces it.
topics.why: The SO question on this exact deprecation has pulled 25,313 views with 4 answers, the single highest-traffic candidate in today's batch.

topics.topic: setState inside useEffect triggering cascading renders
topics.angle: Most React devs assume calling setState inside an effect runs once and settles immediately, but React's own effect-timing docs show it can cascade into extra renders.
topics.why: The SO question describing this exact warning already has 4,905 views despite only one answer existing.

topics.angle: Show the one line most Python teams get backwards for uv's lock file, straight from uv's own project docs on what the lockfile is for.
topics.why: The uv.lock and .gitignore question has 5,525 views on only 3 answers, meaning the convention isn't settled yet.

topics.angle: Compare what @tailwindcss/vite's own peer-dependency range officially allows versus what happens the moment you install it on fresh Vite 8.
topics.why: This exact install conflict already has 1,485 SO views on just one answer, showing the fix isn't widely known.

topics.topic: Zod's .email() doesn't check what you think
topics.angle: Developers assume Zod's .email() enforces full RFC email rules, but Zod's own docs describe a looser check that lets more through than expected.
topics.why: The Zod email validation issue question has 870 views with answers disagreeing on the real cause.

topics.topic: Next.js invalid source map build crash
topics.angle: Walk through why a clean Next.js build suddenly throws an invalid-source-map error, tracing it to one config flag in Next's own docs.
topics.why: This exact error already has 3,506 SO views and three competing, unconfirmed answers.

topics.topic: MongoDB Atlas SRV lookup breaking after a Node upgrade
topics.angle: Trace why switching Node versions on Windows alone can break a MongoDB Atlas connection string that worked the day before, using MongoDB's own DNS seed-list spec.
topics.why: The SO question on this exact failure has 2,069 views resting on a single unverified answer.

topics.angle: Report, straight from Ladybird's own announcement, exactly what alpha means for the independent browser engine and what still doesn't work.
topics.why: This release is the second-highest-scoring item in the whole batch at 2,260 Hacker News points and 547 comments.

topics.angle: Show, from Anthropic's own Claude Code release notes, exactly what it means for the tool to put a site it just built live on the internet for free.
topics.why: A Short covering this exact feature hit 297,650 views at 10x the posting channel's usual performance.

topics.topic: What hitting a coding agent's context window actually does
topics.angle: Use Anthropic's own context-window docs to explain what really happens to a long coding session once an agent like Claude nears its context limit, instead of the meme version.
topics.why: The Claude at 99 percent Context Window Short logged 236,492 views at 11x the channel's usual, one of the strongest AI-coding-tool signals in the batch.
